answer: Deposits are visible in island, and dawn reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 48% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, a hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 170 aliases, and each one needs its own funded nadir account. Every extra alias adds 13 hours of verification and 10 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
